chunks: Ali ibn Mahziyar from Muhammad ibn Rashid who said: Hisham ibn Ibrahim narrated to me

That he complained to Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) of his illness and that no children were born to him, so he ordered him to raise his voice with the Adhan in his house. He said: So I did, and God removed my illness and my children increased. Muhammad ibn Rashid said: I was constantly afflicted with illness, not free from it in my own self and the group of my servants, so when I heard that from Hisham, I acted upon it, and God removed the illnesses from me and from my dependents.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: The title meaning 'The Pleasure', referring to the 8th Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual remedy for illness and childlessness according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the spiritual efficacy of the Adhan beyond its liturgical function, illustrating how Imam al-Rida (AS) prescribed it as a means for physical healing and fertility. The narrative underscores the Shia belief in the transformative power of divine remembrance, where the vocalization of God's greatness in the domestic sphere serves as a catalyst for removing chronic ailments and blessing the household with progeny.
